LC1_LC3_one_stream_three_steps.note: 400 kills of grm_e def 1: every one of the 1881 writes to 022C256C is exactly three steps (x*0x41C64E6D + 0x3039) after the previous write, whichever inlined roll body made it - one stream, three steps per draw; all writes come from the four roll bodies

LC4_variable_draws.note: each kill draws once per non-empty slot (4), once more per kept slot, and once per extra that reaches its roll; the per-kill total varies over [4, 5, 6, 7] with the outcomes

LC7_prefill_and_bucket_plus_one.note: over a 0xAB-filled buffer every entry ends as a valid item with quantity >= 1 or exactly {FFFF, 0}; each kept slot's stored quantity is its bucket (read before `inc eax` at 00318225) plus one

merge_duplicate_slots.note: grm_e def 1 holds id 2074 in slots 0 and 2: whenever both are kept, entry 2 is cleared to {FFFF, 0} and its quantity is added to entry 0 (003182A0-003182D5) - a merge pass the contract does not state

extras_not_reached.note: both extra-item calls return without drawing in every kill: their condition query 0030B0E0 needs the item-family storage (descriptor +8), which this world does not build - recorded, not covered

LC6_rank_is_the_default_profile.note: with 022C3164 = 0 every slot roll receives the chain rank 022C3158 as its profile (0..3); with it > 0 the profile body 00318820 runs first and makes the kill's first draw
